features.text: LIGHTWEIGHT THERMOPLASTIC DESIGN: Provides durable, rigid support for foot drop and peroneal paralysis without bulk.
GAIT-CORRECTING STRUCTURE: Promotes natural foot lift and alignment for improved mobility and balance.
CUSTOMIZABLE FIT: Easily modified using cast scissors or a heat gun for personalized comfort and stability.
LOW-PROFILE SHAPE: Fits inside most footwear for discreet all-day wear.
UNIVERSAL APPLICATION: Suitable for left or right foot and multiple neurological or orthopedic conditions.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
